title: Audit record (C8). Chained per node: prev_hash is the SHA-256 of the previous record's stored bytes. Readers ignore unknown fields (not strict), except fields named like secrets, which make the record invalid.

time.description: C4 event.Received; always the node clock

transcript_sha256.description: D1-25: C2 transcript.sha256, the SHA-256 of the session transcript exactly as stored. Required on device.session.close and on no other action.

collector_seq.description: C7-A5-2: the collector's number for an event it reported. Required on device actions, credential.use, credential.suspend, register.verify and register.activate, on collector.request allowed or denied, and on the collector's result of a credential install, revocation or clearing (audit.CollectorReported). VerifyCollectorSeq finds an omitted record as a gap.

previous_high.description: 0.2: on collector.seq_reset only, required there. The highest collector_seq the node recorded before the reset.

first_seen.description: 0.2: on collector.seq_reset only. The number on the reply that showed the reset; absent when the node found it by the install key before sending.

install_key_id.description: 0.2: on collector.install_key, collector.seq_reset and collector.seq_reset_ack only, required there.

code.description: The C2 code that set it; on asset.suspend except for reason operator, never on a clear

suspension.description: 0.2: on asset.suspend and asset.suspension_clear only, required there. The ref is correlation_id.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the manifest's bytes as the node read them

items.description: Seqs the manifest lists, at most last_seq - first_seq + 1

clear_sha256.description: On quarantine.cleared only, required there: SHA-256 of clear-quarantine.json as applied

requested_by.description: On quarantine.cleared only, required there: the principal clear-quarantine.json names (not authenticated; the actor is the node)

quarantine.description: 0.3: on quarantine.exported and quarantine.cleared only, required there. The stream is quarantine/<target.asset_id>.

claimed.description: 0.4: on collector.request info only. What the admin-signed request the node sends says, unchecked.

verified.description: 0.4: on collector.request allowed only. C7 CollectorReply.Admin: what the collector checked. The record's actor is the verified person: type human, and id equal to verified.principal (not expressible here).

repeat_of.description: 0.4: on collector.request allowed only, with verified, below collector_seq (not expressible here). The first decision a C7 0.5 repeat answer names; VerifyCollectorSeq counts it as accounted for.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the signed payload bytes as sent (C7 AdminPayloadSHA256)

kind.description: 0.5: the request's C7 kind. On claimed, what the payload says; on verified, what the collector verified

config.description: 0.5: on the configuration actions (config.change_approved, config.baseline_acknowledged, config.change_detected, config.baseline_restored; from 0.7 also config.read_compared and config.reads_removed; from 0.8 also config.baseline_recorded) only, required there. Each action has exactly its own fields (contracts/audit/config.go).

decision_seq.description: collector_seq of the collector's first acceptance of the signed request (approved, acknowledged)

kind.description: The baseline's kind (baseline_acknowledged; from 0.8 baseline_recorded, event only)

baseline_digest.description: C9 or C10 digest of the baseline: sha256 of its stored bytes (every configuration action but config.reads_removed)

reason.description: The approval's reason, printable, at most 256 bytes (approved only)

snapshot_digest.description: The snapshot the read produced (detected, restored)

difference_digest.description: The C9 difference from the baseline (detected only)

read_seq.description: collector_seq of the decision on the read (detected, restored)

unchanged_at.description: Record time of the asset's last run before the read, or of the epoch's collector reset when there is none (detected only)

approval_seq.description: decision_seq of the approval that covers the difference; absent when none does (detected only)

previous_digest.description: The baseline of the same asset and kind this acknowledgement replaces, or, on baseline_recorded (0.8), the baseline the recorded one replaces (C10 Previous); absent for the asset's first

unchanged_read_seq.description: collector_seq of the asset's last run of the same operation before read_seq in the epoch; absent when there is none (detected only)

changes_digest.description: 0.7: C9 0.2 Difference.ChangesDigest: sha256 of the difference's changes array alone, in Compare's order. It names neither snapshot nor baseline, so "the same change" is this digest measured from the same baseline_digest. Never the digest of no changes, sha256 of [] (detected, required from 0.7; read_compared with reason same_change)

change_seq.description: 0.7: seq of the config.change_detected record a same_change read repeats (read_compared only)

removed_count.description: 0.7: how many compared reads of the asset were removed from its configuration stream: the oldest recorded and not yet removed, leaving the two newest (reads_removed only)

removed_first_seq.description: 0.7: snapshot_seq of the first removed read (reads_removed only)

removed_last_seq.description: 0.7: snapshot_seq of the last removed read (reads_removed only)

removed_digest.description: 0.7: sha256 over each removed read's snapshot digest followed by a line feed, in stream order (reads_removed only)

kept_digest.description: 0.7: snapshot digest of the newest compared read at the time, which stays with the one before it (reads_removed only)

snapshot_seq.description: 0.7: seq of the stored record of the compared snapshot in the asset's configuration stream; it increases from one compared read of the asset to the next (read_compared only)

baseline_version.description: 0.8: the recorded baseline's own version, C10 Baseline.Version: 1 for an asset's first and one more for each re-learn (baseline_recorded only)
